lines.name: Dr. Brown
lines.en: Hello, Hyunju. Please have a seat. What brings you here today?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요, 현주 씨. 앉으세요. 오늘 어디가 불편해서 오셨어요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I think I caught a cold.

lines.name: Dr. Brown
lines.en: A cold? I see. What are your symptoms?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I have a fever, a runny nose, and a sore throat.
lines.ko: 열이 나고, 콧물이 나고, 목이 아파요.

lines.name: Dr. Brown
lines.en: A fever, a runny nose, and a sore throat... Let me check your temperature. Hmm, it's 38 degrees. When did it start?
lines.ko: 열, 콧물, 인후통이요… 체온을 재 볼게요. 음, 38도네요. 언제부터 그랬어요?

lines.name: Dr. Brown
lines.en: Since yesterday, I see. Let me look at your throat. Say "Ahh." Your throat is very red. Do you have a cough?
lines.ko: 어제부터군요. 목을 볼게요. "아~" 해 보세요. 목이 많이 빨갛네요. 기침도 하세요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Yes, I have a bit of a cough.

lines.name: Dr. Brown
lines.en: OK. It looks like a bad cold. I'll give you a prescription for three days. Are you taking any other medicine now?
lines.ko: 네. 감기가 심하네요. 사흘 치 처방전을 드릴게요. 지금 드시는 다른 약이 있나요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Yes, I got some cold medicine from the pharmacy.

lines.name: Dr. Brown
lines.en: I see. Then please stop taking that medicine and take this one instead. Get plenty of rest and drink lots of water. Do you have any questions?
lines.ko: 그렇군요. 그럼 그 약은 그만 드시고 대신 이 약을 드세요. 푹 쉬고 물을 많이 드세요. 궁금한 점 있으세요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Could it be the flu? I'm a little worried.
lines.ko: 혹시 독감일 수도 있나요? 조금 걱정돼요.

lines.name: Dr. Brown
lines.en: Don't worry. Your symptoms look like a cold, not the flu. But if your fever goes over 39 degrees, please come back and we'll do a flu test. Anything else?
lines.ko: 걱정 마세요. 증상을 보니 독감이 아니라 감기예요. 하지만 열이 39도를 넘으면 다시 오세요. 독감 검사를 해 볼게요. 다른 건요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: No. Thank you for your kind answer.

lines.name: Dr. Brown
lines.en: You're welcome. Take your medicine and get some rest. Get well soon, Hyunju!
lines.ko: 천만에요. 약 드시고 푹 쉬세요. 빨리 나으세요, 현주 씨!

vocab.example: Yes, I have a bit of a cough.
I'll give you a prescription for three days.
I got some cold medicine from the pharmacy.
I feel a little scared. The movie was scary.
